options.content:
## 🎯 Troubleshooting Poor User Experience

Diagnosing poor user experience in virtual sessions is complex — it requires analyzing multiple layers such as input responsiveness, protocol performance, system load, and network conditions. This dashboard helps simplify that process.

Start by identifying sessions with **high session delay** (input delay + protocol latency), then use the lower panels to investigate **root causes** like app or network performance issues.

> 💡 **Tip:** Click on a username in any data table to **filter the entire dashboard** to that specific user's session.

---

## 🧮 Why Percentiles Matter

Most metrics in this dashboard (e.g. input delay, protocol latency, CPU, RAM, Disk) are calculated using the **80th percentile**, rather than the average or maximum.

- The **80th percentile** means: "80% of the time, values were below this number."
- It helps **ignore brief spikes**, while still highlighting **consistently poor performance**.
- It's more realistic for assessing **typical user experience** than using averages.

---

## 🧪 What Is Session Delay?

**Session Delay** = **User Input Delay** + **Protocol Latency**

- **Protocol Latency**: Measures network-related delay in remoting protocols like ICA or RDP.
- **User Input Delay**: Captures the time between user input (e.g. keypress) and the moment it is picked up by the application — a direct indicator of system/app responsiveness.

---

## 📊 How To Interpret Session Delay

Session delay categories used in this dashboard:

- 🟢 **Excellent**: consistently **below 40 ms**
- 🔵 **Good**: mostly below 40 ms, always **below 200 ms**
- 🟡 **Mediocre**: consistently **below 400 ms**
- 🔴 **Poor**: frequently **above 400 ms**

> ℹ️ [More info on user input delay](https://uberagent.com/blog/uberagent-7-1-preview-user-input-delay-application-responsiveness/)

panels.description: The 80th percentile of protocol latency + input delay for all sessions. Gauges the overall user experience.

targets.query:
uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionUser_s != "sys"
| where SessionUser_s contains "$User"
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| extend delay = SessionInputDelaySumMs_d/SessionInputDelayCount_d
| summarize 
delay = percentile(delay,80),
SessionRpLatencyMs_d =  percentile(column_ifexists("SessionRpLatencyMs_d", 0),80)
by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg)
| extend session_delay = delay + SessionRpLatencyMs_d
| project-away delay, SessionRpLatencyMs_d

panels.title: Session delay overview

targets.query:
uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionUser_s != "sys"
| summarize 
session_count = count_distinct(SessionGUID_g)
by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg)
| sort by TimeGenerated

panels.description: The table lists all sessions in the selected timeframe, sorted by session delay. Click on a session to filter the dashboard.

targets.query:
uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionUser_s != "sys"
| where SessionUser_s contains "$User"
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| extend delay = SessionInputDelaySumMs_d / SessionInputDelayCount_d
| summarize 
user = max(SessionUser_s),
machine = max(Computer),
logon = max(SessionLogonTime_s),
protocol = max(SessionProtocol_s),
state = max(SessionConnectionState_s),
client_ip = max(column_ifexists("SessionClientIp_s","")),
client_name = max(column_ifexists("SessionClientName_s","")),
client_os = max(column_ifexists("SessionClientPlatform_s","")),
client_version = max(column_ifexists("SessionClientVersion_s","")),
ctx_transport = max(column_ifexists("SessionTransportProtocols_s","")),
ctx_apps = max(column_ifexists("SessionPublishedAppsCtx_s","")),
id = max(SessionID_d),
delay = percentile(delay,80),
SessionRpLatencyMs_d =  percentile(column_ifexists("SessionRpLatencyMs_d", 0),80)
by SessionGUID_g
| extend user_machine = strcat(user,"@",machine)
| extend user_without_ad = replace(@"^[^\\]+\\", "", user)
| extend session_delay = delay + SessionRpLatencyMs_d
| project user_machine, session_id = id, session_delay, state, logon, protocol, client_ip, client_name, client_os, client_version, user_without_ad, machine, ctx_transport, ctx_apps
| sort by session_delay desc

panels.title: Session table

panels.description: The 80th percentile of protocol latency + input delay per session

targets.query:
uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionUser_s != "sys"
| where SessionUser_s contains '$User'
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| extend delay = SessionInputDelaySumMs_d / SessionInputDelayCount_d
| summarize 
delay = percentile(delay,80),
SessionRpLatencyMs_d =  percentile(column_ifexists("SessionRpLatencyMs_d", 0),80),
user = max(SessionUser_s),
host = max(Computer),
id = max(SessionID_d)
by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg), SessionGUID_g
| extend user_host = strcat(user, "(", id, ")","@",host)
| extend user_without_ad = replace(@"^[^\\]+\\", "", user)
| extend latency_p80 = delay + SessionRpLatencyMs_d
| project-away delay, SessionRpLatencyMs_d, SessionGUID_g, id
| evaluate pivot(user_host, max(latency_p80))

panels.title: Delay per session over time

targets.query:
uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionUser_s != "sys"
| where SessionUser_s contains '$User'
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| summarize 
protocol_latency =  percentile(column_ifexists("SessionRpLatencyMs_d", 0),80),
user = max(SessionUser_s),
host = max(Computer),
id = max(SessionID_d)
by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg), SessionGUID_g
| extend user_host = strcat(user, "(", id, ")","@",host)
| project-away  SessionGUID_g, id
| evaluate pivot(user_host, max(protocol_latency))

| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionUser_s != "sys"

rtt = max(column_ifexists("SessionRoundTripTimeMs",0)),
user = max(SessionUser_s),
host = max(Computer),
id = max(SessionID_d)
by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg), SessionGUID_g
| extend user_host = strcat(user, "(", id, ")","@",host)
| project-away  SessionGUID_g, id
| evaluate pivot(user_host, max(rtt))

| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer contains "$Computer"

| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| summarize usage = percentile(RAMUsagePercent_d, 80) by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg), Computer
| evaluate pivot(Computer, max(usage))

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| summarize usage = percentile(IOPercentDiskTime_d, 80) by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg), Computer
| evaluate pivot(Computer, max(usage))

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| extend io_latency = IOLatencyMsRead_d + IOLatencyMsWrite_d
| summarize io_latency = sum(io_latency) by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg), Computer
| evaluate pivot(Computer, max(io_latency))

| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| summarize usage = percentile(NetUtilizationPercent_d, 80) by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg), Computer
| evaluate pivot(Computer, max(usage))

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer contains "$Computer"
| summarize usage = percentile(PagefileUsagePercent_d, 80) by bin(TimeGenerated, $time_agg), Computer
| evaluate pivot(Computer, max(usage))
